component.name: droiddeckstores
component.description: Store engine; source lockfile snapshot, not an APK binary inventory.

properties.name: droiddeck:scope
properties.value: Cargo.lock all targets and dependency types; not Android runtime-only; excludes Gradle, vendored C and other native binaries

properties.name: droiddeck:hash-provenance
properties.value: SHA-256 checksums declared in Cargo.lock; crate archives not independently downloaded or verified
